name: Crossy Streets
tagline: One more hop. Watch the traffic.
description: Hop across one shared map of roads, rivers and grassy islands. Dodge the cars, ride the logs and keep moving before the eagle swoops. A crash sends you back to your last grassy checkpoint, but keeps your best distance. The farthest hop in 60 seconds wins.
howToPlay: Tap the four arrows to hop across roads and rivers. Everyone shares the same map.
Dodge cars and ride logs. After a crash, hop again from your last grassy checkpoint.
Reach new rows before the eagle catches you. Your farthest row in 60 seconds wins.
